dogecoin.text: Some fairly sober thoughts from one of the founders of Dogecoin (the so-called "joke currency")  that currently has a $1B market cap. https://t.co/9294501EuO

Pretty much my conclusion on cryptocurrency. I've long been technically intrigued by it, but mostly see that it has become useless practically - seemingly stuck being a vehicle for shady Ponzi schemes. (Jackson is a co-creator of Dogecoin)
